 Fortuna Sittard v Excelsior: play-off push meets recovery mission 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Fortuna Sittard host Excelsior in the Eredivisie on Sunday, 25 October 2026, at Fortuna Sittard Stadion, with the hosts sitting sixth on 15 points and the visitors 10th on 11 as both chase momentum in the top half race.
 Fortuna Sittard hold the recent edge in this fixture, winning four of the past eight meetings. The most recent clash in Sittard ended 2-1 to the hosts in February 2026, while Excelsior won 1-0 at home in October 2025.
 OneFootball Videos
 Form points to contrasting momentum. Fortuna are unbeaten in three league games since their home loss to Ajax, drawing with FC Twente and NEC either side of a win at Willem II. Excelsior are winless in five league matches and have conceded nine goals across their last two outings.
 The hosts are without a string of injured players, including Anthony Descotte, Ole Romeny, Mohammed Ihattaren, Yassin Oukili, Jasper Dahlhaus, Ivan Marquez and Lequincio Zeefuik. Descotte's absence is significant, with the forward among the league's leading scorers on five goals this season.
 Tactically, Fortuna have scored 16 league goals despite averaging 36% possession, so transitions could again be a route to goal. Excelsior's season profile suggests an aerial threat, with five headed goals, 99 open play crosses at 25.25% accuracy and strong aerial duel output. The visitors may look to feed the box, while the hosts, who have made 363 clearances and 67 interceptions, could lean on their back line to absorb pressure.
 A home win would take Fortuna to 18 points and further cement their place in the qualification play-off picture. Victory for Excelsior would move them to 14 points and could nudge them into the top half.
